name: Jennifer Hawks
title: Republican nominee for California State Treasurer (2026); retired businesswoman
background: Hawks is a retired Silicon Valley businesswoman with no elected experience, which she promotes as independence. Her most recent role was on the executive team at Sacred Heart Schools, a Catholic school in Atherton. She is a local Republican Party activist. (CalMatters)

In Ballotpedia's candidate survey she says she experienced significant financial hardship as a young woman, and she runs on treasury transparency, ending what she calls reckless bond investments, and protecting pension security as a CalPERS and CalSTRS board member. She placed second in the June 2, 2026 primary with 24.00%. (Ballotpedia)
